description: Java source code for JwtAuthenticationProvider class, which handles JWT-based authentication within the Eclipse Ditto gateway security module.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: Final class that provides JWT-based authentication, extending TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JwtAuthenticationProvider instance with specified validator and result provider.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the request contains a Bearer JWT authorization header.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate the request by extracting and validating JWT, returning an AuthenticationResult.

methods.name: extractJwtFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts JWT from the Authorization header of the request.

methods.name: getAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Validates JWT and constructs authentication result if valid.

methods.name: buildJwtUnauthorizedException
methods.description: Builds exception for invalid or unverifiable JWT.

methods.name: tryToGetAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Generates AuthenticationResult from JWT, handling exceptions.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Creates a failed AuthenticationResult based on an exception.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the authorization context type, which is JWT.
